research_question: Does the 15-minute range immediately after the traditional 08:20 ET COMEX gold open contain enough price-discovery information that a subsequent completed M1 breakout during the next 85 minutes has executable 30-second continuation on P75?
source_basis: CME gold trading-hours material identifies the traditional gold open at 08:20 ET.
MetaQuotes session-based Opening Range Breakout framework defines a 5-60 minute opening range, then trades confirmed breaks in the break direction.
Contemporary XAUUSD New York breakout systems explicitly target New York opening volatility and confirmed range breaks.

frozen_signal.buy: first completed M1 close above frozen opening-range high
frozen_signal.sell: first completed M1 close below frozen opening-range low
frozen_signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after breakout M1 right edge

failure_rule: If the single preregistered COMEX-opening-range profile fails supply/day or direct-net gate, retire CORB rather than tune it on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
